request.description: Upload a PDF file to be split into pages and renamed via OCR. The file will be encrypted during processing. Returns a task_id.
Check the status of a processing task. Replace {{task_id}} with the actual task ID from the upload response.
Get the processed pay slips organized by employee ID as folder structure. Files are encrypted (.enc) and can be accessed via /secure_file endpoint.
Get the list of folder paths in the output directory organized by employee ID.
Get the list of encrypted PDF files (.enc) in a specific employee folder recursively. Replace {{folder_name}} with the employee ID.
Serve an encrypted PDF file by decrypting it on the fly. Replace {{folder_name}} with employee ID and {{file_name}} with the encrypted filename (.enc). The file will be decrypted and served as PDF.

description:
Postman collection to test the PDF Processor API with cryptography integration.

Workflow:
1. Upload PDF file to /process endpoint (file will be encrypted during processing)
2. Check status by polling /task/{id} until completed
3. Get folder structure via /folders or /download/{id}
4. List files in specific employee folder via /list_files/{folder_name}
5. Access encrypted files via /secure_file/{folder_name}/{file_name} (decrypted on-the-fly)

Base URL: http://localhost:8001

Note: All processed files are encrypted (.enc extension) and can only be accessed through the secure_file endpoint.
